The room was dim, lit only by the glow of a single monitor. Dr. Vance leaned back, his fingers steepled. The junior analyst across the table was sweating, a sheen of panic on his brow.

"You think you can bluff your way into my lab?" Vance said, his voice a low rasp. "Fine. Let's test your clearance."

He tapped the keyboard, pulling up a red-flagged file. His eyes locked onto the analyst's. "Tell me the confidential embargo passphrase."

The analyst's mouth opened, then closed. Nothing.

Vance smiled, cold and thin. "That's what I thought." He closed the screen. "Security escort is on its way."

5736b019c77a301968a355314fc464d77534e78c.text: The terminal flickered as a new figure stepped out of the shadows—a man in a crisp suit, holding a small device. “Dr. Vance,” he said, “your authorization was revoked three hours ago. But I have clearance from the new director.” He tapped the device, and a green light pulsed. “Try again. Now.”
